publication.title: The Holocene vegetation history of northern West Jutland
publication.author: Bent Vad Odgaard

closed_paper_interval_proxy.older_endpoint_source_limit: The paper's 9700 BC boundary is extrapolated; this declared proxy does not newly calibrate it
closed_paper_interval_proxy.calendar_conversion_limit: BC + 1950 is the existing declared arithmetic proxy, not a resolved no-year-zero calendar conversion
closed_paper_interval_proxy.selection_measure: Raw source central age only; neither full uncertainty containment nor overlap

legacy_unbounded_proxy.scope: Historical half-unbounded conditional comparison, not the complete stated paper intervals

proxy_age_rule: BP = BC + 1950, applied to Neotoma calibrated sample ages, not the author's age model
